changelog:
### Privearch v1.2.0 Release - Three-Plane Operating Environment & Explainer Canvas
- Three-Plane Research Workstation: Left (Chat & Intent), Center (Explainer Canvas), Right (Media & Vault), Bottom (Execution Console)
- Explainer Canvas: Interactive Plotly scientific curves, step-by-step KaTeX derivations, real-time HTML5 particle simulation, adversarial claims inspector
- Execution Console: Live terminal-like logs, model latency, memory telemetry, and Run/Stop/Rebuild controls
- Deterministic Scientific Compute: Non-hallucinatory SymPy and NumPy mathematical solver
- Tool Graph Architecture: Extensible BaseToolAdapter and PythonSandboxAdapter with AST security auditing
- Artifact Registry & Provenance Ledger: Complete backward provenance tracking
- Dual-Model Brain-Trust (0.5B Router + 4B Synthesizer + 0.5B Verifier)
- 100% Local Airgap (Zero Cloud Compute, CPU embeddings + 4GB VRAM)
